# Historical star-gauge and fixed-subspace fixtures

These synthetic fixtures were serialized by the unmodified pre-unification
WannierNLQG v1.0.0 implementation. They exercise historical readers independently
of the current writers; they are not material-validation evidence.

- `star_gauge_1_11.h5`: full physical-metric frame/replay contract.
- `star_gauge_1_0.h5`: legacy 1.0 digest/layout produced with the baseline writer's
  explicit legacy version, with modern band-frame markers removed.
- `fixed_subspace_1_1.h5`: sealed projector/frame capsule with Z/U semantics.
- `fixed_subspace_1_0.h5`: the same historical array layout without the later
  Z/U semantics attribute.
- `u_diagnostics_1_5.h5`: empty diagnostic stream with its original root layout.

The norm-conserving QE source in `native_source/fixture.save/` is generated by the
repository's synthetic QE fixture helper. Its exact bytes are retained because
star-gauge provenance binds source-file hashes. Tests pass this source explicitly.
The star capsules contain a synthetic source-path placeholder, not a private
machine path; the baseline writer recomputed their original-version digests after
setting that placeholder. No numerical arrays were changed.

`SHA256SUMS` seals every fixture and source file. Reader tests verify those bytes
before checking old/new semantic and numerical equivalence.
